records.title: Documentary Content ID difficulty
records.author: Visual_Extreme_915
records.publication_date: Exact date unavailable; displayed 24d ago; search date differs
records.finding: Self-described filmmaker reports months of work, unspecified investment and publishing/monetization difficulty with 1990 World Cup excerpts. No prior direct FIFA contact reported.
records.limitations: One self-report; no film title, notices, expenditure or licence inspected. Claims are not automatically strikes or proof that publication was technically blocked.

records.title: Football Shorts hiring offer
records.author: David_2107
records.finding: Operator offers EUR10/day for ten image/headline/music Shorts and reports producing about fifteen in just over an hour; limited budget stated.
records.limitations: Offer, not executed payment or price for licensing help. Different activity from footage commentary; no inferred buyer conversion.

records.title: FIFA archive project enquiry
records.author: FIFA
records.locator: Fields: company, footage, rights, sublicence, territory, period, sponsorship
records.finding: Structured project enquiry exists, including usage and downstream rights requirements.
records.limitations: Form is not a licence, price quote or acceptance. Company fields do not prove individuals cannot apply. No form submitted.

records.title: FIFA archive user guide
records.author: FIFA
records.locator: Access restrictions; Order a collection; Download a collection
records.finding: Commercial archive requires approved access; selected clips are collected and submitted for sales review before download.
records.limitations: Documented workflow, not executed account access. Download process is not a public publication grant.

records.title: FIFA and YouTube agreement
records.author: FIFA
records.locator: Media Partner paragraphs and creator cohort paragraphs
records.finding: Announces official Media Partner opportunities and a creator cohort with archive/tournament access.
records.limitations: Announcement not a universal creator licence. Eligibility, small-channel access, fees and operative terms unestablished. Media Partner rights not assigned to all creators.

records.title: Footage removed from Ange & The Boss
records.author: Cameron Fink
records.publication_date: Exact date unavailable; page says 1y; screenings corroborated as October 2024 by G2P08
records.finding: Named filmmaker reports a $25,000 quote with a 60-second minimum, removed desired footage and used Getty images; other providers reportedly negotiated or waived fees.
records.limitations: Quote not paid expense, current rate or audited contract. Dollar currency unstated. Body says 17 seconds while transcript says 15. One project with G2P07/G2P08.

records.title: The weight of the archive
records.author: Tony Wilson
records.finding: Producer reports uncleared archive burden for same film and a discounted quote of $80,514 for 1,278 seconds at $63/second.
records.limitations: Historical, outside preferred 24 months. Quote not invoice or verified payment; seven-year overall production history not all licensing delay. Same project, not independent recurrence.

records.title: Ange & The Boss project record
records.author: Project team / Documentary Australia
records.locator: Director/Producer credits; festival update; fundraising update
records.finding: Names Fink and Wilson, discusses fundraising for copyright bills and later screenings.
records.limitations: Team-authored updates corroborate attribution/project chronology, not independent audit of licensing prices. Later release counters permanent-block interpretation. Donor identities omitted.

records.title: Bundesliga creator partnership renewal
records.author: Bundesliga Media
records.locator: Announcement opening and Vardy production partnership
records.finding: Documents UK/Ireland 2026/27 creator broadcast arrangements, including Goldbridge renewal and seven Vardy-channel matches with Banijay/Workerbee production.
records.limitations: Selective negotiated partnerships with major talent, not an open small-creator licence or demonstrated affordability. Actual broadcasts/contracts not audited.
